lines.en: Yeah, I'm not a temp anymore. I got Jim's old job, which means that my 10-year high
school reunion it will not say Ryan Howard is a temp. It will say Ryan Howard
is a junior sales associate at a mid-range paper supply firm. That'll show
them. You have no idea how long I wanted to do that. Me too. I think we're just drunk.
No, I'm not drunk. Are you drunk? No. Jim.
Are you really going to marry him? Okay.
Jim is gone. He's gone. I miss him so much. I cry myself to sleep. Jim.
False. I do not miss him.
